card.text: Explore Eros in 3D with cssEarth using mission-derived shape and surface data.

introduction.text: Eros is an elongated rocky asteroid explored by NEAR Shoemaker. Its narrow waist, giant craters and long ridges record a history of impacts.

normal.title: MSI 550 nm reflectance map
normal.summary: Corrected 550 nm reflectance is stretched over a 0.05–0.40 range. Some photographed shading remains in the grayscale image.

infrared.title: MSI 950 nm albedo map
infrared.summary: Corrected 950 nm reflectance, using the same brightness scale as the 550 nm view. Near-infrared imagery shown in grayscale.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Model height relative to an 8,420 m sphere. Colors include Eros's broad shape; the outline is simplified.
